title: Banks Act Circular C5/2016 — Matters of interpretation relating to the liquidity coverage ratio
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters of interpretation relating to the liquidity coverage ratio.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Matters of interpretation relating to the liquidity coverage ratio.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Matters of interpretation relating to the liquidity coverage ratio. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
